Uncultivated and waste lands and all property of the nature specified in section 37 of the Code vests in the Government. Section 9. Extinction of khot’s right of reversion. Section 10. LXVII of 1948 to govern the relations of khot and tenants. Section 16. Rules. Section 17. Repeal.
